title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - IncentiveTableSlot
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/IncentiveTableSlot. This concept describes a slot that belongs to a Incentive Table. Each slot of the Incentive Table consists of a series of (lower) boundaries, each indicating the power at which a change to another incentive takes place. Additionally, each boundary is associated with a IncentiveTableTier. Subclass of Slot per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Slot model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'IncentiveTableSlot'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasIncentive.description: Relationship. This property relates an IncentiveTable element, such as an IncentiveTableSlot or an IncentiveTableTier to the boundaries that it consists of. Relationship to Incentive.
